push.title: L 0-2 vs Two Man Elite | You: 6.6 (bottom 25% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, the 6.6 doesn't tell the whole story. It's one chapter, and you're still writing the book.

DID WELL
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 33%). Win the ball, start the attack. You did both.
+ 1 key pass: +0.1. Good stuff.

WORK ON
- 70% passing (14 of 20, down from your usual 77%). Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Rating came in 0.9 below what your on-ball stats earned. Real talk: Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.
- Funny how forcing passes snagged you and tuxedo_slide both. Remedy: give each other short options.
- 1.4 down on your average. Even the best hitters have 0-for-4 nights.
- Passes attempted: 20. Top midfielders reach 25+. You've got the legs for it.

Back-garden drill: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

Keep chipping away. - Coach Lasso
